what: On card hover, following the cursor position (-1 to 1 from the card center), the card tilts up to 3° at 60rem perspective and drifts 1%, while the inner photo stays scaled 1.05 and shifts the opposite way by 3%, giving depth inside the frame — the label and button (front layer) float .125rem toward the cursor. Following takes .6s, and on release everything returns flat in .8s on the same ‹energy› curve (0.16,1,0.3,1).

options.shift: Share (%) by which the image is pushed the opposite way, default 3 — performers 2.25
options.pull: Share the card is pulled (%), default 1
options.ease: Curve as ‹0.16,1,0.3,1›, default is that one
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Slot that holds a photo and clips overflow
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo pushed the opposite way as it grows
options.[data-fx-part=near]: Layers that pop out to the front (labels, buttons) — multiple allowed

use: Name

from.where: cards.js .pp-ticket · .pp-artist, index.html .pp-update — original depth.js (--card-x/-y · perspective 60rem · tilt 3°/5° · pull 1% · photo 1.05/1.07 · shift 3%/2.25% · front layer .125rem · follow .6 energy · back .8 energy)

note: Not applied under reduced touch and motion. Since the part uses the card transform, the entrance motion is applied to the outer wrapper
